v86.build: official npm release; JIT enabled; explicit v86.wasm with no fallback

toolchains.wasm: emcc (Emscripten gcc/clang-like replacement + linker emulating GNU ld) 6.0.13 (e13ee988ce3d87a738dd8f3661d02223308c412a)

reference.method: Independent Python integer LCG, trial-division prime count and Decimal Leibniz sum

configuration.compilerBuiltins: compiler defaults, matching the ARM QuickJS application
configuration.floatingPoint: SSE2 C arithmetic; standard i386 ABI can use x87 returns and newlib assembly; no fast-math
configuration.clock: host monotonic microseconds, wrapping uint32 extended by the unchanged runner

adaptations: Same UTC timezone adaptation as ARM
Runner: replace only SVC clock read with inl(0xE100)
Syscalls: replace only SVC console/exit with outb(0xE104)/outl(0xE108)
Use newlib _syslist.h MISSING_SYSCALL_NAMES mapping for its i686-elf syscall symbol ABI
Multiboot startup/linker for i386; allocator, limits, wrap extension, JS eval and mailbox unchanged

methodology.round: One new Chromium process per round; one fresh Worker and emulator per case/runtime
methodology.timing: Unchanged official V8 v7 warmup/measurement batches, minimum 32 calls; host monotonic clock in both guests
methodology.order: Rotate case order; alternate dynarmic/v86 order within each case across rounds
methodology.ratio: v86 per-iteration time / dynarmic time; above 1 favors dynarmic
methodology.aggregate: Per round combine Crypto/EarleyBoyer cases geometrically, then eight suites equally; summarize round ratios
methodology.scope: Complete QuickJS execution paths: ARM and x86 ISA, compilers, libc builds, JITs and scheduling differ

ratio: v86 ms per iteration / dynarmic ms per iteration; above 1 favors dynarmic
aggregation: Compute paired case ratios and equal-weight eight-suite geometric means within each round, then summarize complete round ratios; do not divide unpaired time medians
